title: PFC Zekeowski in camp
description: PFC Zekeowski — from Newark, New Jersey — squints in bright sun in a white T-shirt and blue jeans on the graded gravel of the established camp, a GP tent and sandbag walls behind him, dark equipment vans on the skyline.
researchNotes: Larry's own identification (Memories comments, 2026-08-15; archived as data/recollections/giscus-vn-0027-c18032334.json, -c18032337.json, and -c18032343.json). The record's spelling is the 2026-08-15 phonetic rendering — Larry gave the sound twice, first 'Zoo-Cow-Ski' then corrected to 'Zee-Cow-Ski'. On 2026-09-03 he spelled the name himself: 'Zukowski. I don't know the first name.' (2026-09-03-phone-zukowski.json). His own spelling is the one to search; the title and slug keep the earlier rendering. Newark, New Jersey narrows any roster search considerably. The dark vans on the skyline may be the operations van complex of VN-0011. 2026-09-12 (giscus-vn-0027-c18416049.json, -c18416052.json): 'Location: Ton Son Nhut', and of Zekeowski, 'He wasn't in my hooch.'
